overloads.semanticRole: Loads the existing related (One-side) record for the given Many-side field, or creates a new related record in memory if none matches yet.

constraints: If a matching related (One-side) record already exists, this behaves like RELATE ONE and simply loads it into memory; otherwise a new related record is created.
When a new related record is created, you must assign the One-side field(s) from the Many-side field(s) yourself, then call SAVE RELATED ONE to persist it.
